risk_and_sentiment: Sentiment is constructive but selective: 277 positive, 137 negative, and 1267 neutral articles. My read is to avoid treating headline volume as conviction by itself; the more important signal is whether macro-sensitive and technology-sensitive stories are pointing in the same direction.
